q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was a loss of -₹172,227 by order date (net profit), i.e. the business lost ₹172k that month; the main driver was high P&L ad spend vs contribution margin. 

- Net profit (order-date): -₹172,227. Contribution margin was positive at ₹1,021,095 but was more than offset by ad spend.  
- Top revenue → cost flow: Gross sales ₹2,253,539 → Net sales (P&L basis) ₹1,697,336 after Discounts ₹110,359, Returns ₹371,999 and Cancels ₹73,845. Net sales matter because they set the revenue available to cover costs.  
- Cost of goods & operations: Net COGS ₹676,241 (Product cost ₹553,170 + Operating cost ₹123,071 which includes Shipping ₹76,743, Packaging ₹18,237, Payment fees ₹12,919, RTO ₹15,171). This left the ₹1,021,095 contribution margin.  
- Largest outflow: Ad spend (P&L basis) ₹1,193,322 — this single line turned a ₹1.02M contribution margin into the final -₹172k net profit.

Worth checking: ad spend efficiency — a ₹1.19M ad bill wiped out margin; recommend breaking ad spend down by platform/campaign to find low-efficiency pockets.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
